description: Offering registry for the Callora API marketplace. Publishes metadata through a catalog contract and tracks registered offerings.

cross-contract.catalog: OfferingCatalog::put_offering — invoked before persisting registry state

entrypoints.name: initialize
entrypoints.description: Configure the registry with its admin and catalog contract address. May only be called once.

params.name: admin
params.description: Administrator authorized to change registry configuration.

params.name: catalog
params.description: Address of the offering catalog contract used to publish metadata.

entrypoints.name: register_offering
entrypoints.description: Register a new offering in the catalog and track it in registry state.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Offering metadata forwarded to the catalog.

entrypoints.name: register_offering_with_balance_gate
entrypoints.description: Register an offering only if the provider holds at least the required token balance.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Offering metadata forwarded to the catalog.

params.name: provider
params.description: Address whose token balance is checked.

params.name: min_balance
params.description: Minimum token balance required to register.

entrypoints.name: get_offering
entrypoints.description: Return the stored metadata for an offering identified by offering_id.

entrypoints.name: is_registered
entrypoints.description: Report whether an offering identified by offering_id is currently registered.

returns.description: True when the offering is registered.

entrypoints.name: set_catalog
entrypoints.description: Update the catalog contract address used for future offering publications.

errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.description: The registry has not been initialized.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.description: The registry has already been initialized.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The caller is not authorized to perform the operation.

errors.name: InvalidAdmin
errors.description: The supplied admin address is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCatalog
errors.description: The supplied catalog address is invalid.

errors.name: OfferingAlreadyExists
errors.description: An offering with the same id is already registered.

errors.name: OfferingNotFound
errors.description: No offering is registered for the supplied id.

errors.name: InvalidMetadata
errors.description: The supplied offering metadata is invalid.

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.description: The provider balance is below the required minimum.

errors.name: CatalogCallFailed
errors.description: The call to the catalog contract failed.

events.name: initialized
events.description: Emitted when the registry is initialized.

events.name: offering_registered
events.description: Emitted when an offering is successfully registered.

events.name: catalog_updated
events.description: Emitted when the catalog address is updated.

testing.xcontract: contracts/registry/tests/xcontract.rs covers catalog and token callee panic/revert safety
